title: Odd Fellows Day on May 30th
summary: A big carnival-like holiday with parades and lodge bands from other cities.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: He wrote me. Oh. What was the 10th of May like in those times? You know, Oddfellas Day?
Oh, 30th of May. What was that like?
That was a big time. It was like something like carnival, you know, in that old school. Big parade. Different lodges coming from different... cities, you know.
All coming into the convention. From all over. And we'd have them in their bands.
